<div class="research-page">

<div class="research-intro">

<p>
My research focuses on statistical methodology, optimal experimental design,
computational statistics, optimization, and machine learning. I am particularly
interested in developing computational methods for complex statistical
problems, including multi-objective design optimization and robust statistical
modeling.
</p>

</div>


<div class="research-grid">

<div class="research-card">

<div class="research-number">01</div>

<h2>Optimal Experimental Design</h2>

<p>
My research investigates computational approaches for constructing optimal
experimental designs under multiple competing criteria. Current work focuses
on multi-objective optimization involving I-, G-, and D-optimality and the
construction of Pareto-optimal design sets.
</p>

<div class="research-tags">
<span>Optimal Design</span>
<span>Multi-objective Optimization</span>
<span>Pareto Front</span>
</div>

</div>

<div class="research-card">

<div class="research-number">02</div>

<h2>Sequential Experimental Design</h2>

<p>
My research also considers sequential experimental design, where new design
points are selected adaptively using information obtained from previous
observations. I am particularly interested in space-filling strategies and
computational methods for sequentially exploring the design space while
improving the efficiency of data collection.
</p>

<div class="research-tags">
  <span>Sequential Design</span>
  <span>Space-Filling Design</span>
  <span>Adaptive Design</span>
  <div class="tag-break"></div>
  <span>Design Augmentation</span>
</div>

</div>


<div class="research-card">

<div class="research-number">03</div>

<h2>Statistical Methodology & Robust Modeling</h2>

<p>
I study statistical modeling methods with particular interest in robustness
and alternative estimation criteria. Recent work examines logistic regression
under data contamination and compares likelihood-based estimation with
distance-based methods for improving robustness to outliers.
</p>

<div class="research-tags">
<span>Statistical Modeling</span>
<span>Logistic Regression</span>
<span>Robust Statistics</span>
</div>

</div>


<div class="research-card">

<div class="research-number">04</div>

<h2>Computational Statistics & Machine Learning</h2>

<p>
I develop and apply computational optimization methods for statistical
problems, with particular emphasis on particle swarm optimization and
population-based algorithms. My work also explores machine learning methods
and computational implementations using R, Python, and PyTorch.
</p>

<div class="research-tags">
<span>Particle Swarm Optimization</span>
<span>Machine Learning</span>
<span>Scientific Computing</span>
</div>

</div>
